name: india-neighbor-news-dashboard
description: An advanced, high-performance news and tactical telemetry intelligence dashboard (Drishya) monitoring India's border sectors and key global strategic sectors in real-time with comprehensive weather boundary HUDs and multi-source API integration.

scripts.dev: node -e "if(process.env.RENDER) { require('child_process').execSync('venv/bin/python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ' + process.env.PORT, {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('concurrently -k \"npm run dev:server\" \"npm run dev:web\"', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.dev:server: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); let cmd = 'python'; if (fs.existsSync('venv/bin/python.exe')) { cmd = 'venv/bin/python.exe'; } else if (fs.existsSync('venv/Scripts/python.exe')) { cmd = 'venv/Scripts/python.exe'; } else if (fs.existsSync('venv/bin/python')) { cmd = 'venv/bin/python'; } else { cmd = 'python'; } try { cp.execSync(path.normalize(cmd) + ' backend/run.py', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch(e) { process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev:worker: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); let cmd = 'python'; if (fs.existsSync('venv/bin/python.exe')) { cmd = 'venv/bin/python.exe'; } else if (fs.existsSync('venv/Scripts/python.exe')) { cmd = 'venv/Scripts/python.exe'; } else if (fs.existsSync('venv/bin/python')) { cmd = 'venv/bin/python'; } else { cmd = 'python'; } try { cp.execSync(path.normalize(cmd) + ' backend/run_worker.py', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch(e) { process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && (python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt || pip install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || pip3 install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || python -m pip install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || true)
scripts.start: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); const port = process.env.PORT || '3001'; let cmd = 'python3'; if (fs.existsSync('venv/bin/python')) { cmd = 'venv/bin/python'; } else if (fs.existsSync('venv/Scripts/python.exe')) { cmd = 'venv/Scripts/python.exe'; } else { try { cp.execSync('python3 --version', {stdio: 'ignore'}); cmd = 'python3'; } catch(e) { try { cp.execSync('python --version', {stdio: 'ignore'}); cmd = 'python'; } catch(err) { cmd = 'uvicorn'; } } } try { if (cmd === 'uvicorn') { cp.execSync('uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ' + port, {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync(cmd + ' -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ' + port, {stdio: 'inherit'}); } } catch(e) { console.error('Failed to start server:', e); process.exit(1); }"
